name: How the Golden Dawn Read the Tarot
description: This course has been merged into The Golden Dawn — the Map and the Walk. The map (Book T, the attributions, the decans, and the Rider-Waite-Smith deck that grew out of the Order) now sits in one course alongside the walk — the four trumps entered as gates.

metadata.common_name: How the Golden Dawn Read the Tarot

sections.Content:
*This course has been merged into **[The Golden Dawn — the Map and the Walk](course-viewer.html?course=walking-the-golden-dawn-path)** — where who the Order were, the address every card carries, the thirty-six decans and their titles, the two ways the Order used the deck, the Rider-Waite-Smith origin story and the further reading all live now, beside the pathworking practice they belong with.*

Kept here only so old links still resolve.
